```{=html}
<div class="phl-wrap">
  <div class="phl-col">
    <h2 class="phl-head">Four blocs <span>Sixty-Six Wards</span></h2>
    <div class="phl-map" id="phl-map-broad" role="img" aria-label="Philadelphia's divisions in four broad voting blocs"></div>
    <div class="phl-legend" id="phl-legend-broad"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="phl-col">
    <h2 class="phl-head">Eight blocs <span>BBMM</span></h2>
    <div class="phl-map" id="phl-map-sub" role="img" aria-label="Philadelphia's divisions in eight voting blocs, shaded within the four"></div>
    <div class="phl-legend" id="phl-legend-sub"></div>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="phl-tip" id="phl-tip" hidden></div>
```

```{=html}
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/d3/7.9.0/d3.min.js"></script>
<script>
(() => {
  // Left: Sixty-Six Wards' four blocs in its colors (sampled from its "Voting Blocs over time" legend). Right: the
  // eight BBMM blocs (the atlas's live Philadelphia fit), each a Lab-lightness shade of the broad bloc it sits in,
  // darker = more Democratic. Each division's broad bloc is its BBMM bloc's.
  const BROAD = [
    { k: "BV", name: "Black Voters",         color: "#4091F9" },
    { k: "WP", name: "Wealthy Progressives", color: "#EE6178" },
    { k: "HV", name: "Hispanic Voters",      color: "#B88C00" },
    { k: "WM", name: "White Moderates",      color: "#00B38A" } ];
  const BLOCS = [
    { b: 1, g: "BV", color: "#4091F9", name: "The Sound of Philadelphia",            n: 596, pop: 449232, biden: 97, race: "83% Black" },
    { b: 2, g: "WP", color: "#CF455F", name: "Weavers Way & Clark Park",             n: 162, pop: 171608, biden: 93, race: "48% white, 26% Black", ba: 65 },
    { b: 4, g: "WP", color: "#FF8297", name: "Fishtown Lattes & Rittenhouse Brunch", n: 194, pop: 212698, biden: 84, race: "68% white", ba: 73 },
    { b: 3, g: "HV", color: "#9B7300", name: "El Centro de Oro",                     n: 229, pop: 231440, biden: 88, race: "42% Black, 36% Hispanic" },
    { b: 5, g: "HV", color: "#DCAC30", name: "Under the Frankford El",               n: 109, pop: 117473, biden: 80, race: "35% Hispanic, 31% Black" },
    { b: 6, g: "WM", color: "#009069", name: "Manayunk Wall to Mayfair",             n: 140, pop: 144120, biden: 68, race: "48% white" },
    { b: 7, g: "WM", color: "#00B38A", name: "Pierogies & Pho on the Boulevard",     n: 160, pop: 168364, biden: 55, race: "59% white, 13% Asian" },
    { b: 8, g: "WM", color: "#4BDAAF", name: "Rizzo's Rowhomes",                     n: 113, pop: 108843, biden: 42, race: "76% white" } ];
  const byB = Object.fromEntries(BLOCS.map(x => [x.b, x])), byG = Object.fromEntries(BROAD.map(x => [x.k, x]));
  const esc = s => String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, c => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;" })[c]);
  const fmt = n => n.toLocaleString("en-US");
  const ink = hex => { const c = [1, 3, 5].map(i => parseInt(hex.slice(i, i + 2), 16) / 255);
    return c.reduce((s, x, i) => s + [0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722][i] * x ** 2.2, 0) > 0.36 ? "#111" : "#fff"; };
  const totPop = BLOCS.reduce((s, x) => s + x.pop, 0);
  const sum = (g, f) => BLOCS.filter(x => x.g === g).reduce((s, x) => s + x[f], 0);

  // ---- legends ----
  document.getElementById("phl-legend-broad").innerHTML = '<ol class="phl-broad-list">' + BROAD.map(G =>
    `<li data-g="${G.k}" tabindex="0"><span class="phl-chip" style="background:${G.color}"></span>
      <span class="phl-name">${G.name}</span><span class="phl-meta">${fmt(sum(G.k, "n"))} divisions &middot; ${Math.round(100 * sum(G.k, "pop") / totPop)}% of residents</span></li>`).join("") + "</ol>";
  document.getElementById("phl-legend-sub").innerHTML = BROAD.map(G => `<div class="phl-group">
      <div class="phl-share">${BLOCS.filter(x => x.g === G.k).map(x => `<span style="flex:${x.pop};background:${x.color}"></span>`).join("")}</div>
      <ol>${BLOCS.filter(x => x.g === G.k).map(x => `<li data-b="${x.b}" tabindex="0">
        <span class="phl-swatch" style="background:${x.color};color:${ink(x.color)}">${x.b}</span>
        <span class="phl-name">${esc(x.name)}</span>
        <span class="phl-meta">${fmt(x.n)} divisions &middot; Biden 2020 ${x.biden}%</span></li>`).join("")}</ol></div>`).join("");

  // ---- two maps of the same divisions; hovering either shows the division on both ----
  const tip = document.getElementById("phl-tip");
  d3.json("../files/philadelphia-blocs/divisions.geojson").then(geo => {
    const W = 600, H = 640;
    const path = d3.geoPath(d3.geoIdentity().reflectY(true).fitSize([W, H], geo));
    let focus = null;
    const maps = [["phl-map-broad", b => byG[byB[b].g].color], ["phl-map-sub", b => byB[b].color]].map(([id, fill]) => {
      const svg = d3.select("#" + id).append("svg").attr("viewBox", `0 0 ${W} ${H}`);
      const divs = svg.append("g").selectAll("path").data(geo.features).join("path")
        .attr("d", path).attr("class", "phl-div").attr("fill", d => fill(d.properties.b));
      const hot = svg.append("path").attr("class", "phl-hot");
      divs.on("pointermove", (ev, d) => show(d, ev)).on("click", (ev, d) => show(d, ev));
      svg.on("pointerleave", () => show(null));
      return { divs, hot };
    });
    function show(d, ev) {
      maps.forEach(m => m.hot.attr("d", d ? path(d) : null));
      if (!d) { tip.hidden = true; return; }
      const p = d.properties, B = byB[p.b], G = byG[B.g];
      tip.innerHTML = `<b>${esc(p.name)}</b>
        <div class="phl-trow"><span class="phl-chip sm" style="background:${G.color}"></span>${G.name}</div>
        <div class="phl-trow"><span class="phl-swatch sm" style="background:${B.color};color:${ink(B.color)}">${B.b}</span>${esc(B.name)}</div>
        <div class="phl-tnum">Biden 2020 <b>${p.biden}%</b> &middot; bloc probability <b>${Math.round(100 * p.p)}%</b></div>`;
      tip.hidden = false;
      const r = tip.getBoundingClientRect(), x = ev.clientX + 14, y = ev.clientY + 14;
      tip.style.left = (x + r.width > innerWidth - 8 ? ev.clientX - r.width - 14 : x) + "px";
      tip.style.top = (y + r.height > innerHeight - 8 ? ev.clientY - r.height - 10 : y) + "px";
    }
    const paint = () => maps.forEach(m => m.divs.attr("opacity", d => focus == null ? 1 :
      (focus.b ? d.properties.b === focus.b : byB[d.properties.b].g === focus.g) ? 1 : 0.13));
    document.querySelectorAll(".phl-legend li").forEach(li => {
      const on = () => { focus = li.dataset.b ? { b: +li.dataset.b } : { g: li.dataset.g }; paint(); }, off = () => { focus = null; paint(); };
      li.addEventListener("pointerenter", on); li.addEventListener("pointerleave", off);
      li.addEventListener("focus", on); li.addEventListener("blur", off);
    });
  });
})();
</script>
<style>
.phl-wrap { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 2.5rem; align-items: start; margin: 1rem 0 2rem; }
.phl-head { font-size: 1.15rem; margin: 0 0 .5rem; border: 0; padding: 0; }
.phl-head span { font-weight: 400; color: #777; font-size: .9rem; margin-left: .4rem; }
.phl-map svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; max-height: 78vh; }
.phl-div { stroke: #fff; stroke-width: .3; transition: opacity .15s; }
.phl-hot { fill: none; stroke: #111; stroke-width: 2; pointer-events: none; }
.phl-legend { margin-top: 1rem; }
.phl-legend ol { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; }
.phl-legend li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.7rem 1fr; column-gap: .55rem; padding: .22rem .35rem; margin-left: -.35rem; border-radius: 6px; cursor: default; }
.phl-legend li:hover, .phl-legend li:focus-visible { background: #f2f1ee; outline: none; }
.phl-broad-list li { margin-bottom: .3rem; }
.phl-group { margin-bottom: .7rem; }
.phl-share { display: flex; height: 6px; gap: 2px; margin: 0 0 .25rem 2.25rem; max-width: 16rem; }
.phl-share span { border-radius: 2px; }
.phl-chip { grid-row: span 2; display: inline-block; width: 1.7rem; height: 1.7rem; border-radius: 4px; }
.phl-chip.sm { width: .8rem; height: .8rem; margin-right: .45rem; border-radius: 2px; }
.phl-swatch { grid-row: span 2; width: 1.7rem; height: 1.7rem; border-radius: 50%; border: 1.5px solid #111; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-weight: 700; font-size: .78rem; }
.phl-swatch.sm { display: inline-flex; width: 1.15rem; height: 1.15rem; font-size: .62rem; margin-right: .4rem; border-width: 1px; }
.phl-name { font-weight: 600; font-size: .92rem; line-height: 1.25; }
.phl-meta { font-size: .75rem; color: #666; }
.phl-tip { position: fixed; z-index: 50; pointer-events: none; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #bbb; border-radius: 5px; box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.15);
           padding: .5rem .65rem; font-size: .82rem; max-width: 19rem; line-height: 1.4; }
.phl-trow { margin-top: .3rem; display: flex; align-items: center; }
.phl-tnum { margin-top: .35rem; color: #444; }
@media (max-width: 800px) { .phl-wrap { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
</style>
```
